run_vasp_relaxation_inputs: run the script to generate VASP input files for the top k best adsorbate-slab configurations for relaxation calculations
run_vasp_single_point_inputs: run the script with the --sp flag to generate VASP input files for single point energy calculations
build_vasp_input_files: build VASP input files from a cached pickle of MLR-processed adsorbate-slab systems sorted by energy
review_VASP_FLAGS: review the default VASP_FLAGS dictionary that configures ibrion, nsw, nelm, encut, and xc functional settings
test_write_vasp_input_files: test the write_vasp_input_files function from fairchem.data.oc.utils.vasp with custom vasp_flags and an output directory
